title: Steve Jobs introduces iPhone in 2007
summary: An excerpt from Steve Jobs's January 2007 Macworld keynote in which he introduces the original iPhone. It shows the pitch of a phone, music player and internet communicator, along with the live demo.
why: HN treats it as the model product demo and MVP showcase, and as a reminder of how constrained the first iPhone hardware was.

quote.text: If you want to se the ultimate MVP demo of a product look no further than the 2007 introduction of the Apple iPhone
